name: member-list-01
title: Member List 01 - People With Presence And A Last-Seen Reading
description: A dense row list for an application surface: a portrait, a name, a role, one of three presence tones beside the caller's own words, a last-seen reading and a slot for the caller's row actions. The tones are mapped here and the words are the caller's, because a presence is a claim about a colleague. Nothing is formatted and no member, word or presence is passed in as anything but a prop.
